Fix is PR #1588 (branch claude/mcp-admin-fastpath-hijack, unmerged at the time of writing) — this fixture fails on the pre-fix selector both on hit@5 (expected tool absent) and on the forbidden assertion (AdminFacadeTool selected). Second admin-fast-path lock: the phrase 'accounts receivable' again trips the bare 'accounts' keyword, so this fixture reproduces the #1588 hijack for a different persona. NOTE (code-vs-plan conflict): FinancialReportingServiceImpl.generateAgedReceivables uses each invoice's CURRENT balance with historical aging dates, so a back-dated asOfDate does NOT reconstruct a true point-in-time balance — the plan §3 W1.2 claim and the getAgedReceivables tool description overstate this. Actor deliberately holds NO admin permission: with only accounting/reporting codes gated in, AdminFacadeTool cannot be returned at all, which is what makes the forbidden assertion satisfiable. q13-ar-pareto is the fixture that grants security:user:view to reproduce the #1588 hijack conditions.
